# Panda Facts

Did you know giant pandas spend **10 to 16 hours a day** eating? They consume between **26 to 84 pounds of bamboo daily** and spend the remaining time sleeping and resting. Unfortunately, because of a mutation in their **Tas1r1 gene (a gene that registers umami and protein flavor)**, they do not find meat appealing to consume. Regardless of food choice, they probably would be **big Instacart users** if given access to an account. So, if you ever meet a panda, please **share your account** with them!!! Find more plots on Instacart [here](Flexdashboard.html).
